items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I saw him with Zoot a couple of times.

ctx.x: So who were the other bass players around New York at that time that you would go out of your way to go see?

To go see? Slam Stewart. One of my favorite nights of jazz I ever heard was Slam with Illinois Jacquet. It was a quartet setting at the Village Vanguard. And he didn’t use any amp and he had gut strings on an old Kay bass with a little ribbon microphone out front. Sounded great. That was one of my favorite experiences.
